Package org.geysermc.paletter

Record Class ItemExplanation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.geysermc.paletter.ItemExplanation
Record Components:
identifier - the item identifier asked for
aux - the aux (damage) value asked for
blockState - the block state asked for, as {name, states}, or null
handle - its handle, or null if it has none in this palette
kind - how it was resolved for this palette's version (ADAPTED does not occur for items)
chain - the identifiers involved: the requested item, then the item it resolved to if that is another one
item - the identifier of the item that is sent, or null if nothing fits
runtimeId - the runtime id of the sent item definition, or -1
damage - the damage value that is sent
block - the block sent with the item (its block item's block, or the default block), or null
blockRuntimeId - the runtime id of that block, or -1
creative - whether the variant is in the creative inventory
creativeGroup - the creative group it is in, or null if it is loose or not in the creative inventory
@Experimental public record ItemExplanation(@NonNull String identifier, int aux, @Nullable org.cloudburstmc.nbt.NbtMap blockState, @Nullable BedrockItemVariant handle, @NonNull ItemExplanation.Kind kind, @NonNull List<String> chain, @Nullable String item, int runtimeId, int damage, @Nullable String block, int blockRuntimeId, boolean creative, @Nullable String creativeGroup) extends Record
What a palette does with an item variant, for debugging: Palette.explain(String, int, NbtMap).
Since:
1.0.0
